apiBoundary: OCC layer — outbound calls go through custom OCC adapters/connectors with converters/normalizers and OccEndpointsService config; never inline HttpClient in components or feature services

build.UNIT_TEST: ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless   # Karma/Jasmine default; swap to 'npx jest' if the app uses Jest
build.E2E_TEST: MANUAL: run the project's e2e suite (Cypress/Protractor) — wire the real command when present
build.SSR_BUILD: npm run build:ssr   # only if SSR is enabled

researchLayers.name: cms-components
researchLayers.targets: CMS components + feature modules, component mapping (ConfigModule cmsComponents), outlets, slots, lazy-loading

researchLayers.name: facades-connectors
researchLayers.targets: facades, connectors, adapters, converters/normalizers — the OCC data pipeline

researchLayers.name: state
researchLayers.targets: NgRx actions/reducers/effects/selectors, StateUtils, store feature registration

researchLayers.name: occ-config
researchLayers.targets: OccEndpointsService config, custom OCC endpoints/adapters, backend contracts, auth/session lifecycle

researchLayers.name: build-config
researchLayers.targets: angular.json, environment files, SSR setup, i18n translation chunks, SCSS theming/tokens

manualVerificationSurfaces: Dev server route — ng serve, then the CMS page/slot the component renders in
Responsive check — Spartacus breakpoints (xs through xl)
Browser console + network tab — no errors, and the OCC request/response shape
i18n — the affected translation keys resolve in every configured language
SSR build, if enabled — the route renders server-side without browser-only API errors
sliceExample: Slice 1: OCC adapter/connector + converter/normalizer + its unit test (BUILD, UNIT_TEST). Slice 2: facade + NgRx state wiring (BUILD, UNIT_TEST). Slice 3: CMS component + module mapping + template/SCSS, with loading and error states (BUILD, LINT, UNIT_TEST).
triggerVocabulary: Spartacus, Composable Storefront, CMS component, outlet, slot, facade, connector, adapter, normalizer, NgRx, OccEndpointsService, cxTranslate, feature module
_notes: Starter profile for an Angular SAP Composable Storefront (Spartacus). Adjust Angular/Spartacus versions to the app after install.

The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative for Spartacus conventions: feature modules + lazy loading, CMS component mapping via CmsComponentData, smart/presentational split, outbound I/O behind OCC adapters/connectors (not inline HttpClient), i18n via cxTranslate, SCSS via placeholder-selector overrides.
UNIT_TEST defaults to Karma/Jasmine (ng test). If the app uses Jest, set UNIT_TEST to 'npx jest' and keep the *.component.ts/*.module.ts mapping.
A verb that runs zero tests is not a pass. Read the reported count before calling a checkpoint green.
Pair with the spartacus-* knowledge skills (component, state, occ, routing, styling, forms, i18n, testing, upgrade) if this repo carries them.
Enable the SSR verb only if the app has Angular Universal / @spartacus/setup SSR configured.
Counterpart profile: react-storefront (React/Vite). Same qrspi skill — only the config differs.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session; 'manual' otherwise; 'none' if there is no Jira.
